Title: Talisman of Meign
Effect: Grants a bonus to Melee damage for a short duration. Upgrades increase this effects and its duration.
Overview: A talisman so precious to the previous owner, they held it close until their last moment. Would they have survived if they had dropped it?

Title: Hilt of Gram
Effect: Grants a burst of Rage and applies Stun to nearby enemies. Upgrades increase the amount of Rage gained,
Overview: Once referred to as the Dragon's Bane, Gram isn't what it once was, but will fell many more foes before its days are done.

Title: Glaive of Dødher
Effect: Throw a Bifröst chakram that swerves into enemies. Upgrades increase the number of chakrams thrown.
Overview: The glaive thrown by the Einherjar is synonymous with death. It's said there is no surface it cannot cut.

Title: Hilt of Hofuð
Effect: Distort space and time by creating a Realm Shift. Upgrades increase the duration of this effect.
Overview: The sword once wielded by the Watchdog of the Aesir, Heimdall. It has separated many heads from their bodies.

Title: Hilt of Hrotti
Effect: Applies a mark to nearby enemies. Attacking a marked enemy reduces Runic Cooldowns of the equipped weapon. Killing a marked enemy grants a Blessing of Runic. Upgrades increase the duration of the mark.
Overview: Said to be kept in Fafnir's Storeroom. It must have been looted before our visit.

Title: Hilt of Forsbrandr
Effect: Push enemies back with force and grant an aura of protection. Upgrades increase the duration of this effect.
Overview: A sword forged to bring justice, protecting those with righteous cause.

Title: Huldra Project
Effect: Turn Mimir's discomfort into a bifröst blast against nearby enemies. Upgrades increase the strength of this effect.
Overview: Brok and Sindri carefully measured and constructed a harness to weaponise the Smartest Man Alive.

Title: Mótsognir's Call
Effect: Create a shockwave that deals high Stun to surrounding enemies. Upgrades increase the strength of this effect.
Overview: Sindri's tuning fork. Somehow it survived Ragnarök

Title: Hilt of Skofnung
Effect: The sword unleashes its power from the souls within... Upgrades increase the strength of this effect.
Overview: The broken hilt of the King Hrólf Kraki. Once known as the sharpest sword in the realm, it houses the souls of the King's 12 bodyguards.

Title: Hilt of Angrvaðall
Effect: Slash forward three waves of light that deal increased damage against enemies afflicted with Sonic. Upgrades reduce this ability's cooldown.
Overview: Known as 'The Stream of Anguish', the broken sword hilt of Frithiof is said to burn brightest in war time.

Title: Hilt of Dáinsleif
Effect: Slam the ground to create an explosion of Seiðr Poison, leaving behind a hazard. Upgrades increase the amount of hazards.
Overview: Formerly the sword of King Högni. It is renowned for creating wounds that never heal.

Title: Hilt of Ridill
Effect: Unleash a wave of Shock to electrify enemies. Upgrades increase the area of effect.
Overview: It's said the sword once belonged to the Dwarf Reginn. The sword now possesses the power of its former owner.

Title: Hilt of Tyrfing
Effect: Charge the sword to sacrifice Health and deal damage based on the amount of Health lost. Upgrades reduce this ability's cooldown.
Overview: Tyrfing has a long and bloody history. Perhaps it is better that only the hilt remains
